{{Quote|One time on Cyborrea, we had to drop from sixteen miles up!|A [[Unidentified Republic rocket-jumper|Republic rocket-jumper]]|<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Cyborrea''' was a heavy-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of both the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Cyborrean]]s and the [[Dog/Legends|dog]]-like [[Nek/Legends|nek]] beasts. Cyborrea was a part of the [[Hutt Empire]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,100 BBY]], with Cyborreans serving in the [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during that [[Time/Legends|time]]. More than [[11,939 BBY|thirteen millennia later]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a [[Fleet/Legends|battle-fleet]] toward Cyborrea during [[Third Pius Dea Crusade|one]] of the Republic's [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] against the Hutts. At some point prior to the conflict known as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], members of the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|rocket-jumper]] unit dropped to Cyborrea's surface with [[ROCKET|rocket packs]] during a [[Mission to Cyborrea|mission]] to the planet. During the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] [[Attacks on Hutt Space|attacked]] and destroyed entire fleets over Cyborrea using a [[Force phantom]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders [[Attack on the Cyborrea system|attacked]] the [[Cyborrea system/Legends|star system]] Cyborrea was located in.

==Description==
Cyborrea was a high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DES" /> that was located within the [[Cyborrea system/Legends|Cyborrea system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> called the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]],<ref name="SisarRun" /> which connected it to the worlds of [[Dirha]] and [[Sionia]].<ref name="TEA" /> Cyborrea was home to aggressive [[Dog/Legends|dog]]-like creatures known both as [[Nek/Legends|neks]] and Cyborrean Battle Dogs,<ref name="DES" /> which were bred and trained on the planet<ref name="AGSWU3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> and ensured a wide-spread reputation for their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|A mass exodus from Sriluur, Cartel forces turning on each other in blind panic, a monster swallowing fleets whole over Cyborrea.|Imperial [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Rove (Ambassador)|Rove]], recounting the Dread Masters' [[attacks on Hutt Space]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Cyborrea constituted a part of the [[Hutt Empire]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,100 BBY]], when members of Cyborrea's native [[Cyborrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as heavy [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] in the [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] military [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] during the [[Second Battle of Vontor]] between Kossak's forces and those of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> More than [[12,000 BBY/Legends|thirteen millennia later]] Cyborrea was no longer a part of the Hutt [[Realspace/Legends|Space]],<ref name="EGtW" /> yet during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Third Pius Dea Crusade|Third Crusade]] against the Hutts in [[11,939 BBY|11,939]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] the Republic still launched a [[Fleet/Legends|battle-fleet]] toward the planet.<ref name="EGtW" /> By the year [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the territory surrounding Cyborrea had returned under the control of the Hutts.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point before the conflict known as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]<ref name="TotJ" /> that happened in [[3998 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> members of the [[Republic Army]]'s elite [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|rocket-jumper]] unit were sent on a [[Mission to Cyborrea|mission]] to Cyborrea. During their assignment, the elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had to drop to the planet's surface with [[ROCKET|rocket packs]] from an altitude of sixteen miles.<ref name="TotJ" /> When the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=operation|Karagga's Palace}}</ref> in the year [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] used a [[Force phantom]] to [[Attacks on Hutt Space|destroy]] entire fleets over Cyborrea.<ref name="TOR" />

The population of Cyborrea around the year [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] ranged from 100 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA" /> At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] the Cyborrea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Attack on the Cyborrea system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of the galaxy,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system was held under the control of those invaders until at least 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] that began in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the Hutts had regained control over the region of space containing Cyborrea,<ref name="TEA" /> and it remained so by the year [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Cyborrea was the homeworld of the sentient, war-like Cyborrean species. Members of the species often fought each other in local-scale wars and engaged in military drills.<ref name="SWMBC" /> At some point during their history, the Cyborreans became a client species of the sentient Hutts and served in their armed forces.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cyborrea was first mentioned in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''&mdash;a [[West End Games]] supplement book that was authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published in [[1993]]. The planet later received mentions in several other reference books, which chiefly noted that it was the homeworld of neks. Cyborrea was also mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio adaptation]] that was released in [[1995]] and received an entry in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published in [[2009]]&mdash;placed the planet in grid square S-9. Cyborrea has more recently been mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]]. The [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] web supplement ''[[The Dark Forces Saga]]'' that was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in 2005 mentioned a disease called the [[Cyborrean rabies]], however no connection between the rabies and Cyborrea has been provided since.
